summary: @servicetitan/document-title ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared purpose is a small React document.title helper (dist/index.js is a ~100-line library formatting ServiceTitan titles). However, the tarball also ships two undeclared root-level files not listed in package.json 'files' (which declares only 'dist' and 'src'): setup.mjs and a 727KB math_init.js. package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods the bun binary executable (mode 0755), and then execFileSync's the downloaded runtime against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a Bun CJS module with heavy control-flow obfuscation, a rotated string/opcode array, hex-named identifiers, and no readable strings; its filename bears no relation to the package's stated function. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape (a package unrelated to Bun pulling a second language runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload) bypasses scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code, and the payload's behavior at execution is opaque and controlled by the publisher. This fires automatically on `npm install` for any consumer of the @servicetitan scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
